title: Standard smooth algebras lift across any quotient of the base ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I\subset R$ an ideal, and $C$ a standard smooth commutative $R/I$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra]. There exist a standard smooth commutative $R$-algebra $B$ and an $R/I$-algebra isomorphism $B/IB\cong C$, where $IB$ is the ideal generated by the image of $I$ in $B$. No nilpotence hypothesis is imposed on $I$.

proof.text: Choose a finite submersive presentation P of C over R/I. Reindex its generators by ULift to universe max(u,v). Surjectivity of R to R/I gives P.HasCoeffs R. Mathlib Presentation.ModelOfHasCoeffs constructs A = R[x]/(f), with lifted equations, and PreSubmersivePresentation.ofHasCoeffs gives its selected injective minor. Put B = A[1/d], where d is this presentation's Jacobian. Compose its presubmersive presentation with the localizationAway presentation. PreSubmersivePresentation.comp_jacobian_eq_jacobian_smul_jacobian computes the new Jacobian as the image of d squared. IsLocalization.map_units makes this a unit, so SubmersivePresentation.isStandardSmooth proves B standard smooth. No hollow construction or choice from an unproved theorem is used.

Presentation.tensorModelOfHasCoeffsEquiv identifies (R/I) tensor_R A with C. Its value on the base-changed Jacobian is P.jacobian, by tensorModelOfHasCoeffsEquiv_tmul and SubmersivePresentation.aeval_jacobianOfHasCoeffs. Compose TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor (B/IB to (R/I) tensor_R B), IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight (base change commutes with localization), IsLocalization.algEquivOfAlgEquiv (transport along the model equivalence), and the inverse of IsLocalization.atUnit restricted to R/I (localizing C at its unit Jacobian changes nothing). This gives the required R/I-algebra equivalence. Raising the generator universe already makes B inhabit Type(max(u,v)). Empty index sets and zero algebras are covered by the same Mathlib constructions.
